name: @payin/address-tool
description: HD wallet address generation and management tool for PayIn

scripts.bun:build: mkdir -p build && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile build/payin-tool-macos-arm64 --target=bun-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile build/payin-tool-macos-x64 --target=bun-darwin-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile build/payin-tool-linux-x64 --target=bun-linux-x64
scripts.bun:macos-arm64: mkdir -p build && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile build/payin-tool-macos-arm64 --target=bun-darwin-arm64
scripts.bun:macos-x64: mkdir -p build && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile build/payin-tool-macos-x64 --target=bun-darwin-x64
scripts.bun:linux-x64: mkdir -p build && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile build/payin-tool-linux-x64 --target=bun-linux-x64
scripts.pkg:build: npm run build:prod && pkg dist/index.cjs --targets node18-macos-arm64,node18-macos-x64,node18-linux-x64 --output build/payin-tool
scripts.pkg:macos-arm64: npm run build:prod && pkg dist/index.cjs --targets node18-macos-arm64 --output build/payin-tool-macos-arm64 --public
scripts.pkg:macos-x64: npm run build:prod && pkg dist/index.cjs --targets node18-macos-x64 --output build/payin-tool-macos-x64
scripts.pkg:linux-x64: npm run build:prod && pkg dist/index.cjs --targets node18-linux-x64 --output build/payin-tool-linux-x64
